content_units: Melbourne Pharmacy Shortlist for After-Work Prescription Pickup
Best fit for your priorities:   Southbank Chemist  . It stays open   past 20:00 every day  , has   wheelchair access  , and supports   prescription pickup after work   most reliably.
Ranked Pharmacy Comparison
Rank   Pharmacy   Late Hours   Wheelchair Access   After-Work Pickup Fit   Verdict
1   Southbank Chemist     Daily until 22:00     Yes   Excellent   Best overall match
2   Carlton Care Pharmacy     Mon-Fri until 21:00     Yes   Very good on weekdays   Strong runner-up
3   Docklands Pharmacy   Mon-Fri until 19:00   Yes   Limited   Accessible, but misses late-hours priority
4   Fitzroy Health Pharmacy   Mon-Sat until 20:30   No   Good hours, poor accessibility fit   Fails a major requirement
Why This Ranking Fits Your Priorities
1) Southbank Chemist
-   Strongest match   for the stated preference for locations open   past 20:00  .
- Open   every day until 22:00  , which gives the best buffer for pickup after work.
-   Wheelchair accessible  , so it meets the accessibility requirement cleanly.
- Delivery is a bonus, though your main need is in-person pickup.
2) Carlton Care Pharmacy
- Very solid option if you mainly collect prescriptions on   weeknights  .
- Open   Mon-Fri until 21:00  , so it still satisfies the   past-20:00   preference.
-   Wheelchair accessible  .
- Ranked below Southbank because its late hours are   not daily   and weekend hours are much shorter.
3) Docklands Pharmacy
- Meets the   wheelchair access   need.
- Delivery is available.
- Main drawback: closes at   19:00 on weekdays  , so it is   not ideal for after-work pickup   if you finish around standard office hours.
- This misses your strongest stated preference.
4) Fitzroy Health Pharmacy
- Hours are decent at   20:30  , which is better than Docklands for late pickup.
- However, it has   no wheelchair access  , which is a major constraint given your requirements.
- Because accessibility is essential, it ranks last despite better closing time than Docklands.
Best Choice by Use Case
Option 1:   Southbank Chemist     Best overall for late-night reliability and accessibility     Open daily until 22:00
Option 2:   Carlton Care Pharmacy     Best weekday alternative if Southbank is less convenient     Mon-Fri until 21:00
Option 3:   Docklands Pharmacy     Only worth considering if location convenience matters more than late hours     Wheelchair accessible but closes by 19:00 weekdays
Context for This Ranking
I prioritized your needs in this order:
-   Open past 20:00
-   Wheelchair access
-   Good fit for prescription pickup after work
Any option failing wheelchair access was treated as a major trade-off, even if hours were otherwise decent.
